rows.text: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 governs the placing on the market. Placing is the first making available, which happens on 25 January 2027, after Directive 2006/42/EC is repealed and the Regulation applies from 20 January 2027 (Corrigendum points 5, 6 and 10). The 10 January signing date does not change this.

No. On 1 December 2026 the Directive 2006/42/EC still governs, and under its Art. 12(4) a non-harmonised Annex IV machine may only use EC type-examination (Annex IX) or full quality assurance (Annex X). Unit verification (module G) is not admitted; the Regulation that lists it applies only from 20 January 2027.

These correspond to Directive 2006/42/EC Annex IV points 14, 15, 16 and 18, which the Regulation replaces from 20 January 2027.
